use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

let columns = 15
let rows = 14
let spacing = 50.0D
let radius = spacing / 3.0D
let offset = radius / 2.5D
let step = 2.0D * Math.pi / 15.0D

let image = IMAGE(
    cast int(spacing) * (columns + 1), cast int(spacing) * (rows + 1))

image.view(
    0.0D, spacing * cast double(rows + 1),
    spacing * cast double(columns + 1), 0.0D)

image.clear(0ub, 125ub, 0ub)

for row in 0..rows do
    for column in 0..columns do
        let x = spacing * cast double(column + 1)
        let y = spacing * cast double(row + 1)
        let angle = -step * cast double(row + column)
        let dx = offset * Math.sin(angle)
        let dy = -offset * Math.cos(angle)

        image.colour(255ub, 255ub, 255ub)
        image.disc(x + dx, y + dy, radius)

        image.colour(0ub, 0ub, 0ub)
        image.disc(x - dx, y - dy, radius)

        image.colour(0ub, 0ub, 255ub)
        image.disc(x, y, radius)
    od
od

write_line("a {columns} by {rows} grid of edged discs")

image.write("drift.png")

image.show("drift.png")
